Shadowing

Play the model voice, record yourself, compare, then rate your attempt. This works even when iPhone speech recognition is unavailable.

Home section: Travel Mode

Travel Mode

final trip layer

Use this when the trip is close. It pulls your most practical survival sets into a simple 7-day review path.

Match Mode

A separate option for matching flashcards with their Greek counterparts. Most rounds have 5 pairs; final category rounds may be shorter so every card is covered without duplicates.

Home section: Phrase Builder

My Greek Phrase Builder

Save your own Greek. You can keep it only in Phrase Builder, or add it into Speak Now as a phrase / Vocabulary as a word.

English to save: this box is automatically copied from what you typed above, so after Google Translate opens you only need to paste the Greek translation.
Phrase: saved phrases appear in Speak Now under the selected category. The Greek is used for both casual and formal unless you edit later.
Home section: Backup / Restore

Backup / Restore

Export your progress before changing browsers or uploading a new version. This saves marks, Listening Review, and personal Phrase Builder entries only. It does not change the app content.

Progress is stored only on this device/browser. Export or download a backup regularly, especially before travel or app updates.
Tip: export and copy your backup after a long study session.

Priority Review

Only three states: Priority Needs Review, Priority Mastered, and Unmarked.
